title: Aeronautica
description: A Survival Modpack based around Create: Aeronautics
body:
Aeronautica is a survival oriented modpack based around Create and Create: Aeronautics, containing several Create plugins and several Quality of life mods.

This Modpack contains Iris and optional included shaders and resource packs.

Feel free to use Aeronautica as a base for another modpack or to use Aeronautica in videos and on streams!
